string-array.name: novidades
string-array.item: Movies: the dubbed and subtitled copies of the same movie are now one item in the grid; the details page opens your preferred version and has a button for the other
Games › Your crew: Discord bots (names ending in “bot”) no longer show up

string-array.name: roteiro_perguntas
string-array.item: In Movies › All, does a movie with a “LEG” copy appear only once, and does its details page offer the other version?
In Games › Your crew, are the Discord bots gone, with the people still there?
With a wallpaper plugin installed, does choosing the “Plugin background” theme show its background on the home screen?
Hold OK on an app › “Change icon”: does picking an icon from a pack change it on the home screen?
